none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: The objective and components may be nonconvex; neither convexity nor strong convexity is required.

problem_class.label: quasar
problem_class.details: F is (γ, μ)-strongly quasar-convex relative to a global minimizer x⋆: F(x⋆) ≥ F(x) + ⟨∇F(x), x⋆−x⟩/γ + μ‖x−x⋆‖²/2, with 0 < γ ≤ 1 and 0 < μ ≤ L.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ContinuizedSimilarQuasar.lean: spec.valid and the minimizer clause in spec.admissible.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: Minimize F(x) = (1/n)∑ᵢ fᵢ(x), with n ≥ 1 and differentiable components.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query (i, x) returns exactly ∇fᵢ(x), for every call index and oracle seed. Each component-gradient evaluation counts as one oracle call; a full gradient costs n calls. Function values are not supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ContinuizedSimilarQuasar.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, and oracle equality in spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: gradient_similarity
distinctive_assumptions.details: Centered component gradients satisfy (1/n)∑ᵢ‖(∇fᵢ(x)−∇F(x))−(∇fᵢ(y)−∇F(y))‖² ≤ δ²‖x−y‖² for all x,y, with δ ≥ 0. This is an average squared-norm condition, without a small-δ restriction, interpolation requirement, or bound on component gradients at x⋆.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ContinuizedSimilarQuasar.lean: spec.valid and averaged gradient-similarity clause in spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: quadratic_growth
distinctive_assumptions.details: F(x)−F(x⋆) ≥ γμ‖x−x⋆‖²/[2(2−γ)] for every x, relative to the same minimizer appearing in strong quasar convexity.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary real Hilbert space. Only the average objective must have L-Lipschitz gradient; componentwise L-smoothness is not assumed. The initial gap satisfies F(x₀)−F(x⋆) ≤ Δ. All parameters, including E, n, L, μ, γ, δ, Δ, ε, and x₀, are public; the component functions and minimizer are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvex.lean: Gradient.Public; LongTails/Setups/SimilarFiniteSumQuasar.lean: Params; LongTails/Setups/ContinuizedSimilarQuasar.lean: spec.Public, spec.publicInput, and spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return an E-valued output X with an integrable objective gap and E[F(X)−F(x⋆)] ≤ ε for some global minimizer x⋆, where ε > 0.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The guarantee is in expectation under the algorithm and oracle seed law. The supplied convergence framework requires a fixed oracle-call budget valid for every seed; success is not required almost surely.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: This formulation combines strong quasar convexity allowing nonconvexity with average squared centered-gradient similarity, smoothness only of the average objective, and arbitrary Hilbert-space geometry.
